# creative-it

> creative-it Software Consulting e.U. — AWS Serverless & Agentic AI consulting
> by Günther Wieser, based in Gösing am Wagram, Austria. One specialist, not an
> agency: serverless architecture, AI agents on AWS Bedrock (GDPR-compliant),
> fractional CTO work, and cloud cost optimization.

The site is bilingual: English at the root, German under /de/.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://www.creative-it.com/services/): the four services with scope and deliverables
- [AWS Serverless Architecture](https://www.creative-it.com/services/aws-serverless/)
- [Agentic AI & GDPR Compliance](https://www.creative-it.com/services/agentic-ai/)
- [Fractional CTO](https://www.creative-it.com/services/fractional-cto/)
